_doc: Combo abilities (M3): splicing both listed parts onto one chimera discovers the combo, permanently logged in the save for the Splice-Dex (M7). Combat effects resolve through the keyword system in M4 — 'keyword' here is the design intent, display-only for now. ~12 combos at v0.1; 4 ship with M3.

combos.name: Injection
combos.desc: Every bite delivers a bonus Venom stack. The lab smells like regret.

combos.name: Squeeze Play
combos.desc: A hug with a clause. Traps the target.

combos.name: Slipstream
combos.desc: Strike, then simply decline to be there. Evasion up after attacking.
